key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
Has a history of permanent atrial fibrillation
Has a history of complete heart block
Has a pacemaker implanted in the late 1990s
Pacemaker was upgraded to a biventricular system
Heart rate was 84 beats per minute
Respiratory rate was 16 breaths per minute
Oxygen saturation was 99% on room air
Computed tomography angiography showed a large middle cerebral artery territory
Electrocardiogram showed a ventricular-paced rhythm with ventricular bigeminy

raw.rationale: The patient's history of permanent atrial fibrillation and the presence of a large middle cerebral artery territory on computed tomography angiography are consistent with a cardioembolic stroke, which occurs when a blood clot forms in the heart and travels to the brain, causing a stroke.

rejected.label: Ischemic stroke
rejected.why: While ischemic stroke is a broad category that includes cardioembolic stroke, the specific details of this patient's case, such as the history of atrial fibrillation, point more directly to a cardioembolic cause.

rejected.label: Moyamoya disease
rejected.why: There is no indication in the patient's history or the imaging studies that suggest the presence of moyamoya disease, which is a rare condition caused by narrowing or blockage of the internal carotid artery and its branches.
